WITH customer_annual_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customerid,
    c.segment,
    SUM(y.consumption) as total_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE SUBSTRING(y.date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  AND c.currency = 'CZK'
  GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment
),
min_consumption_per_segment AS (
  SELECT 
    segment,
    MIN(total_consumption) as min_consumption
  FROM customer_annual_consumption
  GROUP BY segment
),
segment_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    m.segment,
    m.min_consumption,
    COUNT(c.customerid) as customer_count,
    SUM(c.total_consumption) as total_consumption
  FROM min_consumption_per_segment m
  JOIN customer_annual_consumption c 
    ON m.segment = c.segment 
    AND m.min_consumption = c.total_consumption
  GROUP BY m.segment, m.min_consumption
),
segment_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    segment,
    total_consumption / customer_count as avg_consumption
  FROM segment_stats
),
segment_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    a.segment as segment1,
    b.segment as segment2,
    ABS(a.avg_consumption - b.avg_consumption) as consumption_diff
  FROM segment_averages a

WITH consumption_by_segment AS (
  SELECT 
    c.segment,
    SUBSTR(ym.date, 1, 4) as year,
    SUM(ym.consumption) as total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'EUR' 
  AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND SUBSTR(ym.date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.segment, SUBSTR(ym.date, 1, 4)
),
segment_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    c1.segment,
    c1.total_consumption as consumption_2012,
    c2.total_consumption as consumption_2013,
    ((c2.total_consumption - c1.total_consumption) / c1.total_consumption) * 100 as percentage_increase
  FROM consumption_by_segment c1
  JOIN consumption_by_segment c2 ON c1.segment = c2.segment
  WHERE c1.year = '2012' AND c2.year = '2013'
)
SELECT 
  segment,
  ROUND(percentage_increase, 2) as percentage_increase
FROM segment_changes
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing
